Name: Mercy Ring (for Pelipper Town)
Author: GrokCodeReliant
Description:
Tired of knocking out the Pokemon you wanted to catch? Put on the Mercy Ring.

While you wear it, your hits - and your companion Pokemon's attacks, poison and burn - can't knock out Pelipper Town's wild Pokemon. They hold on at 1 HP, ready for a Poke Ball. Take the ring off to fight normally. Inspired by the Mercy Ring in Palworld.

Only Pokemon are affected. Regular Stardew monsters, villagers and other players are untouched.

[size=4][b]WHERE TO GET IT[/b][/size]
Marlon's Adventurer's Guild sells the Mercy Ring for 500g. It works in either ring slot and can be combined with other rings.

[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0 or newer
- Pelipper Town (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344) and its requirements (SpaceCore)

[size=4][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI and Pelipper Town first, and make sure the game launches with them.
2. Download the Mercy Ring zip from the Files tab (Mod Manager / Vortex download works too).
3. Manual install: open the zip and drag the "MercyRing" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder (Steam default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods). You should end up with Mods\MercyRing\manifest.json.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI. The SMAPI console should list "Mercy Ring 1.0.0" with no red errors.
5. Visit Marlon at the Adventurer's Guild, buy the ring, and equip it.

[size=4][b]MULTIPLAYER[/b][/size]
Every player needs the mod installed, including the host. Each player's ring only protects Pokemon from that player's own hits and their own companion, so a friend without the ring can still knock a Pokemon out.

[size=4][b]SETTINGS (optional)[/b][/size]
After the first launch, Mods\MercyRing\config.json is created:
- Enabled: true/false
- ShopId: "AdventureShop" (Marlon), "SeedShop" (Pierre), or "" to not sell it
- Price: gold cost

[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
Built for Pelipper Town 1.2.6. If a future Pelipper Town update changes how wild Pokemon take damage, the ring switches itself off safely and leaves a note in the SMAPI console instead of crashing. Bosses and legendaries are also held at 1 HP while you wear it.

[size=4][b]UNINSTALL[/b][/size]
Delete the Mods\MercyRing folder. Unequip the ring first so it doesn't turn into an error item.
